critical_code_review_comments: server.py:2084-2149 MILESTONE_TITLE_MAP is a static dict — clean, readable, easy to maintain. Adding a new default assignment_key or extending past week 14 is trivial (mapping.get(week) falls back to 'Week N' cleanly).

server.py:2152-2163 _default_milestone_title correctly special-cases capstone titles independent of MILESTONE_TITLE_MAP — this means an instructor who sets total_weeks=8 and marks week 8 as capstone still gets a sensible 'Week 8 — Final Consolidated Deck' etc. (not the 'Week 14 — ...' value from the map).

server.py:2412 regex ^\s*Week\s+\d+(?:\s+—\s+Final Deck)?\s*$ — narrow and safe; matches ONLY the stale auto-generated pattern and the legacy capstone label. Custom titles like 'Slides 1-2' or 'Week 5 — My Custom Story' won't match. Verified in prod DB: 168 cohorts scanned, 0 false renames.

server.py:2414 assignments.find({}, {'_id':0}).to_list(length=5000) — hard-cap of 5000 could silently truncate on very large installs (>5000 assignments). Currently prod is at 692, so ample headroom, but consider batching/cursor iteration if this grows. Not blocking.
server.py:2436 The endpoint returns {message, assignments_scanned, milestones_renamed} — matches the review-request contract exactly. Idempotency confirmed empirically (0 renames on 2nd run).

AssignmentsTab.js:607-627 The new button correctly reuses the `migrating` state — this means the two super-admin buttons are mutually disabled while either is in-flight, avoiding double-invocation of migration+regen. Good UX.
